comments.author: maschine
comments.body_html:
“I can’t mount anywhere” checklist

  1. This mod requires SPT 4.0.x. It does nothing on 3.11.
  2. Extract the zip over your SPT game folder (the one containing EscapeFromTarkov.exe). Afterwards these two files must exist: SPT/user/mods/EasyMounting/maschine-EasyMounting.dll and BepInEx/plugins/maschine-EasyMounting.Client.dll. If they ended up anywhere else, the mod is not installed.
  3. Check your server console on startup for the green line [EasyMounting] Applied preset … - if it’s missing, the server half isn’t loading.
  4. Mounting uses the vanilla mount keybind - check your EFT control settings and make sure it’s bound. The mod makes mounting work in far more places; it doesn’t change how you trigger it.
  5. Fika/co-op: the server part goes on the host machine, the client plugin on every player’s machine.
  6. If you edited config.json: no comments, no trailing commas - broken JSON stops the mod from loading.
  7. Still stuck? Post SPT/user/logs/ (latest server log) and BepInEx/LogOutput.log.

comments.author: maschine
comments.body_html:
Yaw and pitch are actually handled differently: Pitch is a server-side parameter that can be changed via the config (vanilla: ±20°, “AnySurface” preset: ±50°, maximum: ±90°), while yaw is calculated on the client side for each weapon and is hardcoded to ±16°.

At what angle is it failing?

Otherwise, feel free to send me a support package.
